RFSweepLevellingSettings.description: Settings that define the levelling behaviour of the RF sweep.

level_to.description: DUT or monitor, which sensor to use for leveling feedback.

off_trigger_delay.description: How long to wait after turning OFF RF source before triggering meters for fast off measurement.

on_trigger_delay.description: How long to wait after turning ON RF source before triggering meters for fast off measurement.

use_GPIB_levelling.description: If true, utilize levelling over GPIB commands.

GPIB_levelling_C.description: constant of integration for the GPIB levelling feedback.

GPIB_levelling_time.description: Duration of levelling via GPIB in seconds (starts immediatley, AM levelling starts after this finished).

use_AM_levelling.description: If true, utilize AM levelling via a voltage source.

AM_levelling_C.description: constant of integration for the AM levelling feedback.

AM_levelling_time.description: Duration of levelling via AM in seconds (after GPIB levelling finishes).

max_source_power_change_dB.description: rf power will not change by more than this ammount in a levelling step

V_off_slow_min.description: in volts. If V_off slow is less than this number, assume an error has occurred and stop the experiment. Only applies to bolometers.

V_off_slow_max.description: in volts. If V_off slow is less than this number, assume an error has occurred and stop the experiment. Only applies to bolometers.

AM_HARDMAX.description: Max allowed power for for the DUT in dBm.

monitor_power.description: Max allowed power for the monitor in dBm.

DUT_power.description: Max allowed power for the DUT in dBm.

calorimeter_power.description: Max allowed power for for the calorimeter_thermopile in dBm.

RF_source_power.description: Max allowed power for for the rfsource in dBm.
